column1: # SESSION 30 harvest manifest — the 35 session-29 clips, located in Higgsfield History
# SOURCE OF TRUTH for this file: the Higgsfield jobs API, not the DOM.
#   Paged 330 jobs back to 2026-07-23. Each job carries params.prompt and results.raw.url.
#   The CloudFront url is UNSIGNED — no query string, no token. results.raw.url is that url verbatim.
#   ⚠ NOT cdn.higgsfield.ai — that host serves only the _thumbnail.webp and 404s on the .mp4.
#   Verified by HEAD on the last clip: 200 OK, Content-Type video/mp4, Content-Length 2654056.
# SELECTION RULE (how mine were separated from Tim's parallel run on the same account):
#   created_at within 2026-08-05 01:40Z..19:10Z AND params.prompt contains an ALLCAPS beat string.
#   That yields exactly 35 — matching qa-boss/SESSION29-FIRE-LEDGER.md. Tim's clips in the same
#   window have no beat string (they open "CAMERA LOCKED, extreme macro..." / "CAMERA ABSOLUTELY
#   LOCKED AND STATIC...") and several were fired 4-at-a-second, so they are unambiguous.
# CROSS-CHECK THAT PASSED: every beat below is the beat the ledger names for that state, and the
#   ledger's VOID clip is independently confirmed by the API as job 2026-08-05T01:18:40Z with
#   params.prompt LENGTH 0 — the prompt-drop defect, visible in the data. It is NOT in this list.
# All 35 jobs report status "completed". None was per-frame QA'd — see HANDOFF §5.4.
# ===== HARVEST VERIFICATION (session 30) — all 35 downloaded and objectively checked =====
# DOWNLOAD:  35/35 OK, 0 failed, 0 name collisions. Landed as qa-boss/raw/<char>-<state>.mp4.
# FFPROBE:   35/35 identical — 960x960, 24/1 fps, 97 frames, duration 4.041667s. 0 outliers.
# CHROMA:    the gate the VOID clip taught. 40x40 corner average, TOP-LEFT and TOP-RIGHT, on
#            BOTH frame 0 and frame 96 (the last). A scene render cannot pass this; the VOID
#            clip was a ruined-city storm scene and would have failed all four samples.
#            Measured (f0 -> f96, corners agree to within ~2):
#            All plates read ~6-8% darker than the source plate and drift ~4-5 units darker from
#            f0 to f96 — generation + compression, consistent across all 35, not a defect.
# 35/35 PASS. No clip shows the VOID failure mode. Content QA (pose/anchor/debris) is separate
# and belongs to the keying + gate stage, not here.
